The hub aims to strengthen air cargo connectivity across North and East India. The Indian government is also focusing on developing cargo hubs and logistics networks. title: 'Unprofessional': Sanjay Manjrekar slams Sri Lanka’s antics in Colombo

title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125m school to shut after 10 yrs

Funding from the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative ceased, prompting the board's unanimous decision to shut down. While offering extensive support services, the school's academic results did not meet state benchmarks. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative is providing financial support for the transition and educational savings accounts.

title: 'I lied': Woman who pretended to be a child for years convicted of fraud

Although she confessed to her masquerade, she maintained that her motivations were rooted in personal vulnerability rather than dishonesty. The court, however, sentenced her to prison for her deceptive actions, highlighting the seriousness of her offenses.

title: Scientists turn plastic bottles and corn waste into protein-rich cookies
content: Researchers at Southern Illinois University Carbondale are developing protein-rich cookies made using plastic waste and agricultural waste. Called µBites, the cookies use PET plastic from bottles and discarded corn stalks and leaves. Programmed yeasts convert processed waste into proteins, fats, acids and flavouring molecules. The NASA-linked project is aimed at developing food for resource-limited environments, including future deep-space missions.

title: US proposes higher H-1B visa filing fees: What companies may pay

This fee specifically targets cap-subject applications, saving universities and research institutions from its impact. Notably, it is distinct from a previously invalidated proclamation payment. Currently, public commentary on this proposal is being encouraged.

While he calls the ecosystem an “unfortunate racket”, Grandmaster Aaryan Varshney offers a counterpoint, saying guidance remains crucial in the computer era. Symptoms such as swelling, fatigue, or modifications in urination might hint at issues. Furthermore, high blood pressure plays a critical role in kidney health, making regular monitoring essential.

content: he was reportedly dejected over his inability to find a job despite a master’s degree from a US university . in 2024, he came to the US and was looking for a new job . he learned Spanish, and we were all amazed by how quickly he picked up new language .

title: 'Standard practice': Trump’s volatility made India decline joint presser with PM Modi
content: govt justified its decision not to have a news conference after PM Modi meeting . official sources cited Trump's "unpredictable behaviour" at media events . despite request from MEA, it said, "let's not do a full news conference"

title: Dr Robert Parry, Ohio pediatric surgeon, draws cartoons on kids’ bandages after surgery
content: paediatric surgeon Dr. Robert Parry started drawing cartoons on kids’ bandages . the tradition began during Parry’s surgical training at the national Naval Medical Center in Bethesda, Maryland . he has drawn everything from superheroes, animals, cars and sports designs based on what his patients love .

title: Ajit Doval’s China visit: NSA, Han Zheng discuss border peace, bilateral ties
content: NSA Ajit Doval meets china vice president Han Zhang in china . the meeting comes ahead of the 25th round of special representatives talks on the India-China boundary question . embassy: Doval and Han discussed ways to maintain peace and tranquillity along the border .

title: ‘US not in economic position to further restrict, no one buys their bombast’: Iran
content: mohammad bagher Ghalibaf hits back at the 'economic onslaught' of the u.s. . he said the united states is not in a position to further restrict its economic relations with other countries . the remarks came after a campaign aimed at cutting Iran’s financial links around the world .

title: 'Dog-barking' remark on students: Tejashwi says BPSC official 'mirrors CM's language'
content: Tejashwi yadav demands an apology from BPSC examination controller Rajesh Kumar . he says official's language "mirrors" the CM language . the remark reflects the "language of the chief minister"

title: SC issues notice to 20 rebel TMC MPs on Abhishek Banerjee's disqualification plea
content: abhishek has asked the top court to direct Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla to expeditiously decide the disqualification petitions pending before him against the rebel MPs . the ruling comes months after a major political setback for the Mamata Banerjee-led Trinamool Congress in west Bengal .

title: From Gen Z wave to heat in 150 days: Nepal PM Balen faces street anger, party unease
content: the former rapper faces protests, parliament heat and RSP dissent . he is under pressure from public protests and parliament and his own Rastriya Swatantra Party . two months after he took office, young protesters returned to parliament demanding his resignation .

title: Trump tightens Iran squeeze, hurting China and India in the process
content: the treasury department has mapped the networks, facilitators and financial channels that Iran uses to smuggle oil and evade sanctions . the detainment is aimed at severing every economic lifeline that sustains this tyrannical regime until Tehran stands alone.

title: From 10% to 100%: Aviation ministry weighs annual dope tests for all pilots
content: the aviation ministry is considering mandating dope tests for all pilots at least once a year . the current rules require dope testing of 10 per cent of the pilot network . but the directorate general of civil aviation is examining whether testing can be expanded to cover every pilot at a random time .

title: Mojtaba Khamenei seen, heard in rare video amid health concerns
content: new video of mojtaba Khamenei emerges amid growing mystery over his health, appearance and whereabouts . the footage comes amid repeated claims by US president Donald Trump that Mojtaban is in "bad shape" and was "seriously injured" following the strikes that killed his father .
